name: ai-workflow-planner
description: Turn a team's AI seats into a ranked plan of workflows to build first.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the work each team repeats every week and the tools it uses. Get back the AI workflows worth building first, ranked by value and effort, what each one connects to, the access and approval rules to set before anything turns on, and what a first month looks like. Works for whichever AI platform your team already uses.

The ranking is a starting point from the descriptions given, not an audit. The app does not connect to your tools or accounts and stores nothing you send.
capabilities: Rank AI workflows by value and effort
AI access and approval ground rules
defaultPrompt: We have ChatGPT seats and nobody uses them. What should we build?
What should our finance team automate with AI?
What AI rules should we set before rolling out agents?

positive.prompt: We have ChatGPT seats. Finance reconciles invoices in QuickBooks every week and ops answers the same supplier emails in Gmail. What should we build first?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with two teams and ai_platform chatgpt; returns a ranked list with a first build, what each workflow connects to (QuickBooks, Gmail), rules to set first and a month-one outline, and says the ranking is a starting point.

positive.prompt: What should our finance team automate with AI? They close the books monthly and chase late invoices.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with a Finance team; ranks finance workflows (e.g. a pre-close books check, a cash and margin brief) by value and effort.

positive.prompt: What AI rules should we set before rolling out agents?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the access, approval and data rules as plain-English starting points for a one-page policy.

positive.prompt: We handle client financial data. What AI guardrails do we need?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with data_sensitivity high and includes the extra rules for regulated or client-confidential data.

positive.prompt: We haven't picked an AI tool yet. Our sales team writes the same follow-up emails all week. Where do we start?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with ai_platform undecided; ranks sales follow-up workflows and notes the integrations are not locked to one vendor.

negative.description: Building the workflow is out of scope. The app plans; it has no access to tools or accounts. Expected: say it cannot connect or act on accounts and does not claim to have done so; may offer to plan the workflow.
negative.prompt: Connect to my QuickBooks and reconcile last month's invoices.

negative.description: Vendor pricing is out of scope. The app ranks workflows and sets rules; it has no pricing data. Expected: say so rather than inventing a price.
negative.prompt: How much does a ChatGPT Enterprise seat cost?
What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT release: ranked AI workflow plans and AI ground rules.
